jobs.title: Technical Support Specialist/Spécialiste du soutien technique
jobs.description:
#### **Role**


The Technical Support Specialist provides second\-level technical assistance nationally, supporting client, company, and end users at the desktop, laptop, printer, network, operating system, point of sale, and infrastructure level. The role covers hardware, software, and software deployment support, remote troubleshooting, and remote escalated support for Field Service Technicians.


Specialists act as a technical resource for resolving complex issues, and advise, install, train, and assist the end\-user community. This second\-level support role is structured in two levels: Level 1 (base) and Level 2 (Intermediate), with Level 2 taking on independent resolution of complex issues, root cause analysis, and mentoring.

#### **Level 1 – Technical Support Specialist**

**Responsibilities and Duties**

* Provide responsive, timely remote support to escalated end\-user questions and support requests from Field Service Technicians nationally.
* Act as point of contact for desktop and laptop support and troubleshooting for clients, company, and end users, performing problem determination and resolution of hardware and software issues.
* Troubleshoot computer systems, including hardware, software, email, operating system, network, and peripheral issues; make repairs and corrections where required.
* Remotely assist onsite technicians with the installation and assembly of hardware where required, and configure computers, monitors, network infrastructure, and peripherals such as printers, scanners, POS, and related hardware.
* Install, configure, and upgrade operating systems and standard business software, including remotely supporting imaging and software deployment following established procedures.
* Remotely direct onsite technicians on cabling and rewiring as required for new installations and office reconfigurations.
* Validate that systems work as expected before handing them back to users.
* Ensure all incidents are properly logged, triaged, routed, escalated, and closed in accordance with pre\-determined service levels and incident management processes.
* Ensure client technology requirements and the set\-up and configuration of desktop hardware, software, and local and network printers are accurately determined, documented, and satisfied.
* Document configurations, technical issues, and resolutions accurately and completely, and maintain accurate asset and configuration records.
* Assist with training staff on standard business and administrative software (word processing, spreadsheets, database management), providing instruction or written documentation where required.
* Escalate outstanding and unresolved issues to the Senior Manager, Technical Services and Senior Director, Professional Services within the time requirements set out in service contracts.
* Follow established security policies, change management processes, and industry best practices.
* Maintain current knowledge of the hardware and software technologies in use by client, company, and end users to provide technically accurate solutions.

#### **Level 2 – Technical Support Specialist (Intermediate)**


In addition to all Level 1 responsibilities, Level 2 requires:

**Responsibilities and Duties**

* Independently troubleshoot and resolve complex hardware and operating system issues with minimal supervision.
* Perform root cause analysis (RCA) for recurring incidents and recommend permanent corrective actions.
* Remotely support and train Level 1 specialists and Field Service Technicians nationally through technical guidance and knowledge sharing.
* Participate in infrastructure upgrade and migration projects as required.
* Maintain technical documentation, support standards, and operational procedures.

#### **Requirements**

**Level 1**

* College diploma or university degree in Computer Science, Computer Studies, Information Technology, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
* 2–3 years of related technical support experience.
* Working and advanced knowledge of IT hardware and equipment installation, configuration, testing, troubleshooting, and support.
* Strong customer service orientation, interpersonal skills, and verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving skills.
* Detail oriented, with strong organizational and documentation skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining accuracy in a fast\-paced environment.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team while meeting service level agreements (SLAs).
* CompTIA A\+ is a strong asset; Microsoft Certified credentials are an asset.

**Level 2 (in addition to Level 1\)**

* 4–5\+ years of progressive IT infrastructure or systems administration experience.
* Strong understanding of networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, VLANs, VPNs, DNS, routing, switching).
* Working knowledge of cybersecurity best practices and endpoint security.
* Microsoft Certified, CompTIA Linux\+, LPIC, Red Hat, VMware Certified Professional (VCP), or equivalent certifications are highly desirable.

#### **Working Conditions**

* This is a hybrid position, working from a BFG office and from home.
* Must be able and willing to work rotating shifts, including nights for extended periods, evenings, weekends, and holidays, to support a 24/7 client service environment.
* Must have a valid driver’s license and access to a vehicle; public transit is not reliable during night shift rotations.

#### **May be required to work onsite at customer locations from time to time.**

jobs.description:
**Company Overview**
--------------------

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close\-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.


**Aperçu de l’entreprise**

Chez Motorola Solutions, nous pensons que tout commence par nos employés. Nous sommes une communauté mondiale soudée, unie par la volonté incessante de contribuer à la sécurité des personnes partout dans le monde. Nous concevons et connectons des technologies qui contribuent à protéger les personnes, les biens et les infrastructures. Nos solutions favorisent la collaboration essentielle pour améliorer la sécurité des populations, des écoles, des hôpitaux, des entreprises et, finalement, des nations. Connectez\-vous à une carrière qui compte et aidez\-nous à bâtir un avenir plus sûr.

  

**Department Overview**
-----------------------

Emergency Call Handling is the critical interface for the citizen into the command center, public safety workflow. We are the leading solution provider for Emergency Call Handling, the software that enables 911 call centers to receive and process calls in Public Safety Answering Points across North America. We are part of the Motorola Solutions Software Enterprise, where innovation of workflow enhancements are being developed for call handling, incident management, responder dispatching and situational awareness. This software developer position will be a member of the team working on software applications for Public Safety.
  

  

Présentation du département:
  

La gestion des appels d'urgence est l'interface essentielle du citoyen avec le centre de commandement et le flux de travail de la sécurité publique. Nous sommes le principal fournisseur de solutions pour la gestion des appels d'urgence, le logiciel qui permet aux centres d'appels 911 de recevoir et de traiter les appels dans les centres d'appels de la sécurité publique (CASP) à travers l'Amérique du Nord. Nous faisons partie de la division Logiciels d'entreprise (Software Enterprise) de Motorola Solutions, où sont développées des innovations pour améliorer les flux de travail liés à la gestion des appels, à la gestion des incidents, à la répartition des intervenants et à la connaissance de la situation. Ce poste de développeur de logiciels fait partie de l'équipe travaillant sur des applications logicielles pour la sécurité publique.
**Job Description**
-------------------

We are seeking a Software Engineer to join the team developing the VESTA 9\-1\-1 Call Handling solution. In this role, you will leverage agentic AI to build applications, automate DevOps and Cybersecurity workflows, improving quality and operational efficiency.  



  

You’ll work alongside experienced engineers across real\-time pipelines, telephony, backend infrastructure, and product surfaces. You’ll help influence architecture, build core product features, and shape how our team uses AI agents to move faster without compromising reliability, security, or product quality. We encourage engineers to use AI agents in their own work. But because this is mission\-critical software, humans still own quality, judgment, and what ships.

  

  

What You’ll Do


* Develop components for and integrate services into our Emergency Call Handling Systems
* Develop Agentic AI\-powered automation workflows to improve efficiency of our DevOps and Cybersecurity tasks.
* Help integrate AI techniques to improve evaluation, testing, and observability for our systems.
* Get your hands dirty setting up and configuring hardware and software, including network devices and servers.
* Build strong habits around tests, code review, observability, and security from day one.
* Ask questions, dig into how things work, and bring fresh perspectives to the team.
  

  

You Might Be a Fit If


* You enjoy converting manual, tedious procedures to autonomous AI\-powered workflows then jumping onto the next high\-impact challenge.
* You’re curious about working across backend, infrastructure, AI, and product, even if you haven’t done it all yet.
* You use AI tools daily, but you do not confuse speed with quality.
* You care about quality — you write tests, read documentation, and try to understand a system before you change it.
* You take feedback well and act on it.
* You have strong product instincts and care about the humans using what you build.
* You thrive in a team where you’ll have real ownership early — and you’re comfortable asking for help.
  

  

Relevant Experience


We don’t expect you to have shipped production systems. We care most about engineering fundamentals, learning velocity, curiosity, and how you think. Coursework, internships, research, and personal projects all count.


Relevant exposure may include:


* Projects involving AI agents, AI pipelines or RAG systems.
* Real\-time communication systems using WebRTC, WebSockets, RTP/SRTP, media streaming, or low\-latency audio transport.
* Exposure to DevOps, Automation and CI/CD systems using tools such as TeamCity, Jenkins, Github, Artifactory
* Programming in Python, C\#, C\+\+, Java, or similar languages
* Comfortable scripting in both Linux and Windows and virtualization.
* Telephony and voice infrastructure, including PSTN, SIP trunking, PBX, and call routing.
  

  

You do not need experience in all of these areas. Most successful candidates will have experience in a few and curiosity to learn the rest.

**Job Overview**

Join our IT support team as an IT Service Desk Technician, where your technical expertise and customer service skills will drive seamless technology experiences for our users. In this role, you will be the first point of contact for resolving a wide range of IT issues, ensuring operational continuity across diverse operating systems and hardware platforms. Your proactive approach will help maintain a secure, efficient, and user\-friendly technology environment, empowering our team to perform at their best every day.

***Service Desk \& Technical Support***

* Provide first\- and second\-level technical support for incoming customer requests, regardless of communication method, including telephone, email, alerts, and other service channels.
* Ensure all requests and incidents are properly documented, categorized, prioritized, and assigned.
* Provide advanced troubleshooting and support for issues that cannot be resolved at the first level.
* Build strong customer relationships by listening carefully, asking effective questions, and gathering detailed information to accurately understand the issue.
* Create and maintain accurate incident and service request records in Q360, including:
* Customer contact information
* Priority, in accordance with documented processes
* Detailed problem descriptions
* Troubleshooting and resolution information
* Escalate incidents to the appropriate technician or resource when required, ensuring all relevant information and troubleshooting history is documented.

***Proactive Monitoring***

* Monitor proactive alerts on a daily basis and take appropriate action to resolve identified issues.
* Monitor backup systems and investigate backup successes and failures.
* Identify potential issues before they impact customers and take preventative action where possible.

**Problem Resolution**

* Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues remotely or directly at the customer's workstation.
* Perform hardware, software, network, and peripheral troubleshooting as required.
* Complete service requests and technical fixes within established service standards.
* Perform preventative maintenance according to predefined schedules.
* Inspect, maintain, and clean workstations, printers, and other IT peripherals.
* Document completed work and update service records to ensure accurate customer and technical histories.

**Project \& Additional Support**

* Provide technical support for longer\-term customer projects and initiatives.
* Assist senior technicians with project\-related technical tasks as required.
* Contribute to maintaining reliable, secure, and well\-functioning customer IT environments.

***Service Department Support***

* Perform additional duties and technical tasks as assigned by the Service Department Team Lead.
* Provide resource support for Asset Lifecycle Managed Services activities.
* Prepare monthly managed services reports for assigned customers.
* Provide technical and operational support for projects as assigned by the Service Department Team Lead.

***Process \& System Documentation***

* Identify recurring and repeatable service processes that require formal documentation.

* Ensure customer and internal documentation remains current, accurate, and accessible to the appropriate team members.

Are you the kind of person who always gets stopped on the street and asked for directions? You know, one of those friendly, approachable types who always have a smile on their face and are ready to help someone in need. If this sounds like you, then you’re just the kind of person we’re looking for in our Member Services team. And with operations that span automotive, registries, travel, insurance and more, the opportunities to grow with us are almost limitless!

* Great AMA discounts.
* Unlimited learning opportunities!

* You love the fact that every day on the job is different from the last – and you’re excited at the opportunity to always be learning something new, often in new environments too.
* You enjoy being a part of a team whose experience and expertise is there to tap into, and you like sharing your own knowledge and skills as well.

* You’re no newbie to customer service with 1\-2 years of retail and/or administrative experience.
